summary: Trust boundary tightened: autonomy predicate is the host-verified run-registry jobId (worker-forged jobId cannot select autonomous rules; omission cannot escape the guard); classifier and its verdict cache unreachable for jobId requests; review round stripped worker-asserted risk_level/risk_category from denials so only host-derived rail risk reaches audit and grant cards (pinned by test). Decision 0121 records the contract; 0115 terminal-denial semantics preserved with the existing one-card recovery.

non_blocking_findings.summary: worker-supplied risk fields survived into audit path when no rail risk existed; fixed this branch - pattern worth a sweep on other IPC request fields carried into decisions
